 Hon'Ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra, J. 
1.
Short counter affidavit filed on behalf of respondents no. 2 and 3 is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and learned counsel for respondents no. 2 and 3.
3.

The instant application u/s 528 BNSS has been filed with prayer to quash the entire proceedings of S.S.T. No. 612 of 2020 (State vs. Mohit and another) as well as charge-sheet dated 22.9.2020 and summoning order dated 28.9.2020 passed by Special Judge, POCSO Act, Fatehpur.

entities.text: S.S.T. No. 612 of 2020 (State vs. Mohit and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that in FIR victim has been stated to be minor and it is alleged that main accused Vimlesh and applicant had committed rape on her.

However, in statement u/s 164 Cr.P.C., the victim has stated that on 6.8.2020 at around 7:00 pm she has made physical relation with accused Vimlesh on her sweet will in a room built in agricultural field; no rape was committed by anyone against her; she is acquainted Vimlesh for 3 to 4 years; FIR was lodged in the case as her co-villager had caught her in jungle; Mohit did nothing with her; he is friend of Vimlesh; she is willing to live with Vimlesh; her actual age is 17 years.

He next submitted that subsequently the victim has solemnized married with main accused Vimlesh and in this behalf Marriage Certificate issued by Marriage Registration Officer on 7.12.2023 has been filed on record.
In said certificate, date of birth of victim is shown as 1.1.2003 and that of Vimlesh is 15.10.1994.

He further submitted that proceedings of entire case has been quashed on application of co-accused Vimlesh by order of this Court dated 21.5.2025 in Application u/s 528 BNSS No. 12284 of 2025 but as the application was filed by sole accused Vimlesh, the present application has been filed by the applicant with a view to avoid any ambiguity in the case.

Learned counsel submitted that the applicant has already been enlarged on bail by order of this Court dated 23.2.2021; the informant has stated that in school record, true age of the victim was not recorded and her actual age was around 17 years at the time of incident.
5. Learned counsel for respondents submits that victim has performed marriage with co-accused Vimlesh and they are also blessed with a child; they are living a peaceful married life at present; the applicant had not committed any bad act with the victim; as was clarified by the victim herself in statement under section 164 Cr.P.C.; neither victim nor her father are willing to prosecute the applicant and it serves no fruitful purpose because compromise has already been entered with the main accused and the victim has solemnized marriage with him.
6.

Learned AGA submits that in case, proceedings are quashed on the basis of compromise between the applicant and prosecution side, any amount received by them as of victim under the SC/ST Act,
they may be directed to refund the same as in previous order in respect of Vimlesh also, no such order has been passed.

7. Considering the amicable settlement of the dispute between the parties through marriage, and in view of the principles laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh v. State of Punjab;
(2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh v. State of Punjab; (2014) 6 SCC 466, which permit quashing Mohit Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158374369/
2 of criminal proceedings in cases involving matrimonial or similar nature of disputes upon mutual settlement, this Court deems it appropriate to exercise its inherent jurisdiction under Section 528 of B.N.S.S.
8.

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No. 612 of 2020, titled State v. Mohit and Another, arising out of Case Crime No. 98 of 2020, under Sections 376-D, 504, 506 I.P.C.; Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act; and Sections 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of the SC/ST Act,
registered at Police Station Asothar, District Fatehpur, are hereby quashed.
9. The application is accordingly allowed.

10. However, it is directed that any amount received by the informant or victim as compensation from the government being a member of SC/ST community, shall be refunded by them and Social Welfare Officer/D.M., Fatehpur shall take necessary action in this regard.

(Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.) September 3, 2025 Dhirendra/
